verification_note: degree detection via re-differentiation initially used a structural contains_var check and failed on 2x+4 -- a 0*x term still has a Var(x) node in the tree even though it's algebraically zero -- fixed by switching to a 3-sample evaluation-based constancy check instead; linear returns exactly 1 root (-2); quadratic positive-discriminant returns exactly 2 roots whose sym_eval_interval brackets match the hand-verified sqrt(2) bracket; zero-discriminant returns exactly 1 (not 2) roots; negative-discriminant returns a genuine complex conjugate pair (i, -i) via the Tower's existing Complex kind -- required routing through multiplication by a real reciprocal instead of complex division, which rust-runtime/src/ir/ops.rs documents as unimplemented at this stage
